chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
every section is built on the tower's own cheeky march tune, carried from the reference
tuba plays the melody low while piccolo and glockenspiel play the oom-pah offbeats up high
phrases that descend where the theme rose, mirror-image melody
reverse-cymbal swishes and backwards-sounding swells into downbeats
comic, topsy-turvy, a funhouse mirror room
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat
seamless transition back to the theme
